name: FOLFOX / FLO (Fluorouracil / Leucovorin / OXALIplatin), metastatic

biomarkers.note: The FOLFOX / FLO cytotoxic backbone (fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin) is not biomarker-restricted. HER2, MMR or MSI, PD-L1 CPS, and Claudin 18.2 are tested to guide add-on therapy (trastuzumab for HER2-positive, checkpoint inhibitor by CPS or MSI-H/dMMR, zolbetuximab for Claudin 18.2-positive) layered onto this backbone. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Gastric Cancer v3.2026, Principles of Biomarker Testing and Systemic Therapy for advanced disease.

lineOfTherapy: first-line systemic therapy for metastatic or unresectable gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma; also an option in later lines

eligibilityCriteria.locator: line 98464 to 98466 (AIO trial: 5-FU/leucovorin/oxaliplatin in metastatic gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma)

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (continuous infusion)

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 96614 to 96616 (FLO/FLOT backbone: 24 hour infusion of 5-FU 2600 mg/m2, day 1, every 2 weeks); AIO 24 hour 5-FU line 98464

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 96615 (FLO backbone, shared with FLOT); the AIO metastatic FLO trial at line 98464 uses a 24 hour 5-FU infusion plus leucovorin with oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2 every 2 weeks. Fluorouracil 2600 mg/m2 IV as a 24 hr continuous infusion on day 1, every 2 weeks. DPYD deficiency raises fluoropyrimidine toxicity risk; consider DPYD testing before first dose.

supportiveCare: This is the FLO (fluorouracil / leucovorin / oxaliplatin) regimen, the gastroesophageal fluoropyrimidine-plus-oxaliplatin FOLFOX-equivalent (FLOT without docetaxel).
DPYD: consider DPYD genotype or phenotype testing before fluoropyrimidine; reduce or avoid on deficiency.
Antiemetics: oxaliplatin-based, moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
Metastatic setting: continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity (cycle number not fixed).

monitoring: peripheral neuropathy assessment before each cycle (OXALIplatin)

doseModificationRules.text: Reduce or hold OXALIplatin per neuropathy grade; obtain clinical review. Physician decides.

divergence.note: The gastric-chapter grounded regimen is FLO (24 hr infusional 5-FU 2600 mg/m2, no bolus). The colorectal mFOLFOX6 variant (bolus plus 46 hr infusion) is sometimes used interchangeably for gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma but its specific 5-FU schedule is not grounded in the gastric chapter. Regimen variant selection left to clinical review.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for FOLFOX-type therapy in metastatic gastric and GEJ adenocarcinoma, grounded as the FLO regimen (fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin). DeVita 12th ed. line 98464 establishes 24 hr infusional 5-FU plus leucovorin with oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2 once every 2 weeks for metastatic gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (German AIO phase III); the exact backbone per-drug doses (5-FU 2600 mg/m2 24 hr infusion, leucovorin 200 mg/m2, oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2 on day 1) are grounded to the shared FLO/FLOT backbone at line 96615. A divergence is recorded distinguishing this FLO 5-FU schedule from the colorectal mFOLFOX6 bolus-plus-46-hr variant, which is not grounded in the gastric chapter. The cytotoxic backbone is not biomarker-restricted; HER2, MMR or MSI, PD-L1 CPS, and Claudin 18.2 are tested to guide add-on therapy. Metastatic intent, cycles not fixed (null). ISMP tall-man applied (OXALIplatin). DPYD screening flagged for the fluoropyrimidine. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
